mapping_selection.question: Which G3 token should failing frozen_protocol.md §5 item 4 (QPAF does not beat train_fitted_static) map to?
mapping_selection.recorded_by: Claude at the Research Lead's request
mapping_selection.source: Research Lead's choice in Claude's structured question in the working session

primary_metric: ViDoSeek page nDCG@10, per query, seed-averaged before the paired query bootstrap (M5.1 statistics)
precedence: BLOCKED: a core-roster acceptance (M5.1, M5.2, M5.3 QARF/QPAF, M5.4 QARF/QPAF, R7, M5.7) is missing or names other report bytes; seeds differ from the three preregistered seeds; query count or W/T/L totals differ from 172; R7 replay differs; a co-strongest baseline contrast or any required value is missing or non-finite
NO-GO: seed-averaged QPAF - matched QARF mean delta < 0.01 or CI95 lower <= 0

LIMITED-CLAIM: any co-strongest baseline mean delta <= 0; top-5% positive-gain share >= 0.90; latency or memory gate failed or not established (accepted M5.5 measurement with >= 1000 measured queries); reload above 1e-7; non-finite outputs

claim_limits.BASELINE_NOT_BEATEN: No claim that QPAF improves on the strongest deployable baseline: QPAF does not exceed the validation-selected train_fitted_static on TEST-172; report this negative result.
claim_limits.GAIN_CONCENTRATION_AT_OR_ABOVE_MAX: No stability claim: the top 5% of positive-gain queries carry at least 90% of the gain.
claim_limits.LATENCY_GATE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: No operational latency claim: the accepted measurement does not meet the 1,000 measured-query rule in metric_policy.md §5.
claim_limits.LATENCY_ABOVE_MAX: No operational latency claim: median added fusion latency exceeds 10.0 ms/query.
claim_limits.CUDA_GATE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: No operational memory claim: no accepted learned-fusion CUDA measurement.
claim_limits.CUDA_AT_OR_ABOVE_MAX: No operational memory claim: peak learned-fusion CUDA allocation is at least 1.50 GiB.
claim_limits.RELOAD_ABOVE_TOLERANCE: No deployability claim: fresh-process reload differs by more than 1e-7.
claim_limits.NONFINITE_OUTPUTS: No deployability claim: a run produced non-finite values.

post_hoc_note: Written on 2026-10-28 after the accepted M5.7 result was known. It adds no threshold: every number comes from frozen_protocol.md §5 and metric_policy.md §5. The only new element is the token mapping, which the Research Lead chose.
